title: EPAN: Finalize Decode as implementation conversion
description:
Deprecate the use of dissector_table_allow_decode_as(). Mark the
function deprecated and remove remaining (superfluous) calls to it.
Make in internal API for it for use within epan.

Detection of support for Decode as can be based on the field
dissector_table->da_descriptions, no more need for the flag field
dissector_table->supports_decode_as. Drop the flag field from
the dissector_table structure and switch over checks to the, now
inlined, function dissector_table_supports_decode_as().

AI-Assisted: no
